description: This file provides a utility function 'inferColumns' for processing data rows and generating column configurations suitable for a DataTable component. It extracts relevant fields based on an allowlist and data presence, and formats specific date fields for display.

methods.name: inferColumns
methods.description: Generates an array of column configuration objects for a DataTable by intersecting the provided rows' fields with an allowlist, applying formatting rules for date fields, and handling missing data.
